result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but the restaurant metadata under the first "Popular right now" card is visibly overlapping and unreadable.

issues.description: Under "Tokumaru Ramen Bar," the delivery-time text ("25–35 min") overlaps the delivery/category metadata ("€0 delivery • Ramen"), causing characters to render on top of each other.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine in a single properly spaced metadata row or separate them into distinct lines with sufficient vertical spacing and responsive text constraints.
